question: A startup wants to avoid purchasing servers before it knows how much capacity customers will require. Which AWS Cloud benefit MOST directly addresses this goal?

Aggregated demand lets AWS operate infrastructure at a scale individual organizations usually cannot match

options.text: Keep the peak capacity running continuously

options.text: Six
Three
Eight
Twelve
